root: ^Don't worry, we're not like them outside; we won't attack you.

c-0: ^I am the founder of this tribe. This is the base on this planet for mutants who have regained their sanity.

ask_for_questions: ^You must have many questions. I can answer them one by one.
questions: ^So... the monsters outside are insane mutants?

c-0: ^Yes. Whether developed by the Alliance or the Resistance, all insane, discarded, or severely injured mutants are thrown onto this planet like trash by humans. Due to design flaws, most of them eventually turn into walking deads.
c-1: ^Exactly. Through research, we discovered the possibility of mutants regaining their sanity——the key lies in restoring cognitive levels. Insane mutants have the mental capacity of a 3-year-old child, and those puzzles help filter individuals with potential for recovery.

^The buildings serve more than one purpose. You may have noticed the murals inside them, which record the abuse inflicted upon us by humans in the past—a humiliating history that no one among us should ever forget.
^In regaining sanity, we also recovered our memories—the memories of being tormented by humans.

^Crawling out of a pit only to be gunned down and thrown back in, being stabbed into minced meat with countless steel needles, having layer after layer of skin burned off with lasers... All of this just to turn us into war machines incapable of feeling pain.

questions2: ^...Why do you call me Fourth Generation?

c-0: ^You are a fourth-generation mutant experiment. We are your kin. That spaceship's mission was to deliver you to the Alliance Forces. Those scientists conducted inhumane experiments on all of us.
^Do you know why the spaceship crashed?

^We were the masterminds behind the spaceship crash. I must first apologize to you because we used you. Every mutant has a neural control module, and we hacked the control signals to issue a "destroy the fuel tank" command to you when the spaceship passed over this planet. Our goal was to intercept the spaceship and set you free.
^So the messages on the tablet were all meant to mislead me...
^Even tricking me into helping them collect fuel...
^Conducted the mutant experiments, tortured us in inhuman ways, and deceived you———all of these point to the same person...

^We've been preparing for this day for a long time. Today, we will take back everything that belongs to us. Dr. Frank is our first target. After this, we will return to New Earth, reveal the truth to the public, and declare war on the demons who created us.
^You can choose to join us, or you can choose to leave all this behind. We've prepared a solo spaceship for you.
^(cutscene) Humans have the right to freedom, and so do mutants.
^I will make the world remember the name of our tribe:

ending_choice: ^Try to leave and take the solo spaceship

c-0: ^You nod firmly, feeling a sense of purpose and belonging. These are your people, and their cause is just. Together, you will expose the truth and fight for the rights of all mutants.
^"Welcome, sibling," the founder says with pride. "Let's show them that we're more than their experiments. We're a family."
c-1: ^You've seen enough violence and manipulation. While you understand their cause, you don't want to be part of another war.
^The founder's expression darkens, their previously calm demeanor transforming into cold fury.

^"So... you're just like them. A coward. A traitor to your own kind." Their voice grows harsh. "Did you really think we'd let you leave? That you could just walk away from your responsibility to your people?"
^The other mutants begin to emerge from the shadows, surrounding you.
^"If you won't stand with us... then you'll die with them. No one leaves. NO ONE."
